bead.title: Harden command wire format and producer path: part 3: part 2
bead.description:
PROBLEM
Parent bead pqueue-b4992731 is too broad for one execution pass. This child owns part 2 of 2 of that parent scope.

ROOT CAUSE
PROBLEM
Parent bead pqueue-60f3bccc is too broad for one execution pass. This child owns part 3 of 3 of that parent scope.

ROOT CAUSE
PROBLEM: the command-kind header is treated as a Rust `Debug` string, records are produced sequentially with blocking timeouts inside the tick path, and startup relies on a fixed sleep to hide readiness races. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue-server/src/wire.rs:29`, `crates/pqueue-server/src/producer.rs:88`, and `crates/pqueue-server/src/main.rs:101` serialize wire data with implicit formatting, call `block_in_place` on the hot path, and wait on `sleep(Duration::from_millis(400))` during startup. PROPOSED FIX: define explicit command-kind serialization/deserialization, batch or async-produce records outside the current-thread reactor, remove the fixed sleep, and make startup readiness event-driven.
NON-SCOPE: tenant/topic canonicalization, listen/bootstrap split.

PROPOSED FIX
Implement only this child acceptance slice:
- `go test ./...` passes for the wire/producer path and its callers.
- `lefthook run pre-commit` passes with the new serialization, producer, and startup tests.

NON-SCOPE
Do not implement parent acceptance criteria assigned to sibling child beads. Preserve every parent non-scope constraint unless this child explicitly narrows it.
